title: Hearthgate Spiral State
description: The synthesised harmonic state produced by the Spiral Engine from DEEPStory, DEEPTime, DEEPTheory, PREMAQ, Desired State, World Profile, and Shared State. No subsystem reads the DEEP datasets directly — every subsystem reads this packet. Placed in DualAspectPacket.harmonic_state.

spiral_state_id.description: Unique ID for this Spiral State packet.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the Spiral Engine produced this packet.

engine_version.description: Version of the Spiral Engine that produced this packet.

phase.description: Current compression-release phase. Derived from the temporal trajectory across DEEPTime and PREMAQ.

direction.description: Directional momentum within the compression-release cycle. Ascending = outward release movement. Gathering = compression accumulating toward the next release. Stable = holding. Pivoting = at a phase boundary. The spiral always moves outward — gathering is not retreat, it is preparation.

confidence.description: Confidence in this Spiral State reading. Below 0.5 signals degraded mode — subsystems should reduce emphasis, not invent.

suggested_actions.description: Ordered list of possible next steps. The Spiral Engine composes, never invents. Every action is traceable to a supporting receipt.

subsystem_contexts.description: Per-subsystem distillations. Each subsystem reads only its own context — not the full packet.

supporting_receipts.description: Immutable reference IDs to the DEEP records that produced this state. Not copied content — only IDs or hashes.

references_only.description: supporting_receipts contains IDs/hashes only. Source records are never copied into the Spiral State.

degraded.description: When active, subsystems reduce emphasis. They do not invent alternate state.

token.description: Machine-readable action identifier. e.g. deepen_scene, reduce_dialogue, widen_world, preserve_silence.

weight.description: Relative weight of this suggestion in the current state. Not a command — a compass reading.

reason_code.description: Traceable origin of this suggestion. Must resolve to a supporting_receipt.

breath_note.description: Narrative pacing guidance. e.g. 'Allow descriptive space before dialogue.'

character_dynamics.description: Per-character trajectory and momentum, keyed by character ID.

directive.description: Sound world instruction. e.g. widen, narrow, deepen, still.

evolution_hint.description: Glyph evolution guidance. e.g. open_path, seal_ring, extend_arm.

attention_level.description: How much the UI should surface to the user's attention right now.

emphasis_tokens.description: UI element tokens to emphasise in the current state.

story.description: DEEPStory record IDs that contributed to this state. Format: deepstory:<id>.

time.description: DEEPTime record IDs that contributed to this state. Format: deeptime:<id>.

theory.description: DEEPTheory record IDs that contributed to this state. Format: deeptheory:<id>.
